quotes.text: Yeah, I know. Look, they've gone ahead of us on that. I mean, I feel like we've got an AI arms race between my office and the insurance companies. Like, you know, hey, I'll see your AI and I'll match it with my own, you know. I mean, that's kind of what we've got.

I mean, look, you can use AI. Uh look, I think it's wonderful. We can use it to, you know, look at population discrepancies. I think we can use it over large data sets to say, hey, you know, Joe Smith, man, he's doing a lot more lumbar fusions than anybody else.
